    First Block with Adeyemi Ajao, Co-founder and Managing Partner at Base10

    By Anastasia Crew

    Startup Marketing Lead

    1 min read
    Share this post

    Uh-oh! It looks like your ad blocker is preventing the video from playing.

    Please watch it on YouTube

    Listen to the First Block podcast on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and your other favorite podcast platforms.

    Download Base10's Founder Framework template here. To learn more about how Notion is supporting startups, please visit notion.com/startups.

    Welcome to First Block, a Notion series where founders and executives from the world's leading companies tell us about the many “firsts” of their startup journeys. Hosted by our Co-founder Akshay Kothari, this series explores the many ups and downs that founders face as they build their companies, and what they've learned along the way.

    Adeyemi Ajao is the Co-founder and Managing Partner at Base10. Base10 is an early-stage venture capital firm investing in the automation of the real economy.

    In this episode, we do a deep-dive into:

    • Creating a company in a crowded market

    • Building and maintaining co-founder relationships

    • The importance of true community

    • Learning to be a CEO

    • Moving from founder to investor

    • Finding a wealth of diverse backgrounds

    What’s in this episode:

    • 28:06 The Life after Acquisition

    • 32:04 Becoming an Investor

    • 35:40 Base10

    • 38:55 The Ultimate Diversity

    • 41:48 A Day in the Life of Ade Ajao
